collection: Manually labelled paraphrases of ordinary developer prompts represented in existing Contexer tests and documentation. This fixture and the Task 04 classifier change landed in the same commit, so repository history does not establish independent pre-tuning holdout provenance. The corpus excludes the frozen adversarial container fixtures, is reported separately as labeled regression evidence, and must not be used as a tuning set.
